resolution.finding: The read-barcode concept maps to TWO distinct current slugs: 1d-barcode-reader and 2d-barcode-reader. Neither is THE canonical URL for read-barcode. The prior catalog URL (barcode/net/read-barcode) no longer maps to a current canonical page.
resolution.reason: read-barcode is ambiguous — 1D and 2D barcode reading are separate product pages on the current site. Assigning either one as the canonical URL for read-barcode would be inaccurate.
resolution.recommended_action: RETAIN_MCU — barcode/read-barcode remains MISSING_CANONICAL_URL. Wave 16 to decide whether to split into two entries or document as composite.

wave16_options.description: Create two new registry entries: barcode/1d-barcode-reader and barcode/2d-barcode-reader. Remove barcode/read-barcode. This accurately reflects the current site structure.
wave16_options.risk: Registry entry count changes; existing CVFP packages referencing read-barcode would be affected

wave16_options.description: Document barcode/read-barcode as a composite entry with two canonical URLs. Update canonical_url to a list or primary/secondary pattern.
Keep barcode/read-barcode as MCU indefinitely until a policy decision is made.
